image.name: duplicati
image.description: [Duplicati](https://www.duplicati.com/) is a backup client that securely stores encrypted, incremental, compressed backups on local storage, cloud storage services and remote file servers. It works with standard protocols like FTP, SSH, WebDAV as well as popular services like Microsoft OneDrive, Amazon S3, Google Drive, box.com, Mega, B2, and many others.

changelog.desc: Make sure /config is only accessible by the PUID user.
Make `latest` stable releases, move beta releases to `development`.
Rebase to Noble, add support for settings DB encryption.
Rebase to Linuxserver LTS mono version.
Allow for additional command line arguments in an environment variable.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Allow access from all hostnames, clarify info on image tags.
Use jq instead of awk in dockerfiles.
Build only beta or release versions (thanks deasmi).

env_vars.name: SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env_vars.desc: Encryption key for settings database. Minimum 8 characters, alphanumeric.

env_vars.name: CLI_ARGS
env_vars.desc: Optionally specify any [CLI variables](https://duplicati.readthedocs.io/en/latest/07-other-command-line-utilities/) you want to launch the app with

env_vars.name: DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_PASSWORD
env_vars.desc: Password for the webui. If left unset will default to `changeme` and can be changed from the webui settings.

volumes.desc: Path to source for files to backup.

image.title: Duplicati
image.setup_instructions:
The webui is at `<your ip>:8200`.

For local backups select `/backups` as the destination. For more information see [Duplicati](https://www.duplicati.com/).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  duplicati:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/duplicati:latest
    container_name: duplicati
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=
      - CLI_ARGS= #optional
      - DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_PASSWORD= #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/duplicati/config:/config
      - /path/to/backups:/backups
      - /path/to/source:/source
    ports:
      - 8200:8200
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=duplicati \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY= \
  -e CLI_ARGS= `#optional` \
  -e DUPLICATI__WEBSERVICE_PASSWORD= `#optional` \
  -p 8200:8200 \
  -v /path/to/duplicati/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/backups:/backups \
  -v /path/to/source:/source \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/duplicati:latest
